name: quay
description: Quay is a local team task board.

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run start --workspace=@quay/server" "npm run start --workspace=@quay/client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@quay/server && npm run test --workspace=@quay/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@quay/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@quay/client
